technical-summary: RSC02 step 5 (#1066): bc-serve start --manifest replays a stored manifest immutably (digest, build, model and device identity checked, typed refusals) and still applies the calibration, power (durable admission before the first GPU child) and lease gates. Named-config starts reuse the measured manifest by a canonical static key (JCS content identity, chunked file fingerprints, atomic per-config index); a changed key measures a fresh manifest and a replaced or missing manifest refuses instead of silently remeasuring. RSC12's power mapping and lab-experiment key projection are not on main and stay refused or deferred.
user-summary-candidate: The C++ serving launcher can restart from a stored manifest and reuse a config's measured manifest when nothing that affects it has changed.
